prompts.survivor: Use case: stylized-concept. Production bitmap asset for a 2D skeletal game, matching the attached MUTED FIELD SKETCH 08 reference exactly in costume, low saturation warm ochre/olive/beige palette, thin uneven dark brown ink lines, sparse flat hand-painted shading and texture. Make ONE modular animation BODY WITHOUT A HEAD: a clean garment collar/neck socket, no head or face, no blood, no injury, no gore. The game's original head will be attached separately, so omit every head/helmet/hair shape. The whole body is lying naturally ON ITS SIDE, fully settled flat along one horizontal ground-contact baseline, relaxed bent knees and arms, no body floating, no feet sticking in the air. This is an unconscious/death terminal body pose for a game, not a scene. Entire cutout visible with generous transparent padding. A real transparent alpha background, no ground, no shadow, no labels, no text, no panel border. Preserve the reference's limb thickness and equipment details. Wide horizontal composition. SUBJECT: ONLY the LEFT hooded survivor from the reference. Keep ochre poncho, olive trousers, bandaged forearms, fingerless gloves, belt pouch, square tan backpack, brown boots and the SAME short angular cleaver held loosely in the near hand. The hood and head are omitted for the separate original head attachment; preserve scarf/collar base. Neck socket at the RIGHT end, feet at the LEFT end. Body rests prone on its side; arms folded naturally near chest, cleaver flat beside the hand, both boots resting on the same ground baseline. No new accessories.
